text:
alex (Sales): Hi team — Acme sent back a CAIQ and a few follow-ups. They want: 1) a concise statement on encryption/KMS shared responsibility, 2) confirmation of whether our hosted tier supports customer-managed keys for PII during POC, and 3) a ballpark POC pricing for 2 weeks (50k tokens/day). Can someone own?
emma (Solutions): I can own the tech answers and POC plan. Quick notes: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private differ here. Will draft a short ownership blurb for the CAIQ.
sanjay (SecOps): Tagging in. For the CAIQ entries re: encryption we should be explicit. Draft suggestion: "Redwood manages encryption in transit and at rest for the Hosted service; customers are responsible for key lifecycle when using Dedicated/Private BYOK integrations. For Hosted, we offer encrypted storage with provider-managed keys; customer-managed keys are supported on Dedicated and Private deployments via KMS integrations and HSM connectors." Is that accurate?
emma (Solutions): That's accurate. Add: "During a Hosted POC, customer data can be protected in-flight and at-rest; if customer requires customer-managed keys for PII during the POC we recommend Dedicated trial or Private deployment — we can provision a small Dedicated pool for the trial."
priya (Legal): For the CAIQ free-text, prefer slightly softer language: "For Redwood-hosted customers, encryption in transit and at rest is provided by Redwood; customers who require exclusive control over encryption keys can use Redwood Dedicated or Private deployments with BYOK integrations. Redwood documents key-handling procedures and can provide SOC reports on request." Also add an action: agreement on who will sign off.
alex (Sales): Good. Customer specifically asked about: "If we ingest PII over the API during POC, who is responsible if keys are compromised?" How do we answer succinctly for sales/legal?
sanjay (SecOps): Short answer: "Customer is responsible for credentials they create and for their data classification and access controls. Redwood is responsible for protecting keys and infrastructure we manage. For BYOK in Dedicated/Private, customer retains control of keys and Redwood cannot decrypt data without customer consent."
emma (Solutions): I'm going to draft the CAIQ text blocks. Also adding a small matrix for the customer comparing modes:
```
Mode: Hosted | Dedicated | Private
Encryption KMS: Redwood-managed | Customer BYOK available | Customer BYOK available
Control plane access: Redwood-managed | Option for customer-managed | Customer-managed
POC recommendation: Quick trial | Predictable isolation | Regulated workloads
```
alex (Sales): Perfect — can you include a short POC cost estimate? They asked for two weeks, 50k tokens/day.
emma (Solutions): Quick calc: 50k tokens/day * 14 days = 700k tokens. For POC we typically do a discounted hosted trial estimate: $0.60 per 1k tokens (placeholder) => 700k tokens = $420. We'll convert to official pricing after finance sign-off. Note: if they need Dedicated provisioned for BYOK, add minimum reserved capacity cost estimate (~$3k-$5k for 2 weeks pro-rated).
priya (Legal): Mark that pricing as estimate and require a PO / trial addendum. I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum template: scope, data handling, liability cap for POC.
sanjay (SecOps): Also: CAIQ question SC-8 on key rotation — add wording: "Redwood rotates service keys regularly; customers using BYOK maintain their own rotation schedule."
emma (Solutions): I'll prepare the CAIQ JSON responses and a short ownership statement for each encryption question. I'll also attach the POC plan (milestones + what we need from customer: sample dataset, network allowlist, contact for key setup).
alex (Sales): Can you drop the CAIQ replies and POC estimate here by EOD? I want to send to the buyer today.
emma (Solutions): Will do. Draft incoming in ~3 hours.
deploy-bot: automated note — acme-poc-dedicated request created #req-3421 (for tracking).
priya (Legal): One more note for CAIQ: where the form asks for evidence links, point to /compliance/soc2 and the encryption whitepaper. I'll provide exact doc IDs.
sanjay (SecOps): Also include: "We provide audit logs and KMS access logs upon request for Dedicated/Private deployments" as an evidence line.
emma (Solutions): Draft posted: 1762508400 — includes CAIQ Q&A blocks, ownership matrix, and POC cost/ask. Sending to Alex and Priya for sign-off.
alex (Sales): Thanks team — I'll await sign-off and then forward to Acme. :thumbsup:
